description: Longtime White House aide Stephen Miller pledged his “absolute loyalty” to President Trump in short remarks Friday evening shortly after being promoted to chief of staff — replacing Susie Wiles “We need to stand with the man who has stood with us with every fiber of his being,” Miller said in a video Trump posted…
title: Miller calls chief of staff promotion ‘honor of my life’ at Mar-a-Lago event

author: Ford McCracken
description: The U.S. launched new defensive strikes against Iran targeting the country’s air defense systems, President Trump said on Friday, describing the strikes as “minor.” The U.S. military previously struck Iran on Monday, just a day before the midterms, targeting Iran’s Qeshm Island, home to an Iranian naval base and in the critical Strait of Hormuz.…
title: US military targets Iranian defense system in latest round of limited strikes

description: Prime Video announced the release of a two-part series on First Lady Melania Trump’s life since her husband returned to office, unveiling a trailer for the new feature on Friday. The series, titled “MELANIA, The Series,” offers new insight into the behind-the-scenes life of the first lady. “The Series reveals never-before-told stories, offering unprecedented insight…
title: Prime Video releases trailer for 2-part Melania Trump series

author: Sarah Fortinsky
description: Mississippi Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith (R) is fighting for her political life as Democrat Scott Colom threatens to pull off one of the biggest upsets of the midterms in a state that hasn’t elected a Democratic senator since 1982. Before polls closed on Tuesday, Decision Desk HQ (DDHQ) gave Hyde-Smith a 91 percent chance of winning…
title: How Scott Colom turned his Mississippi Senate race into a nail-biter
